advice_items.quote: you need to work your ass off and when everything falls apart guess what get your bootstraps on... never quit that is what separates a winner from a loser
advice_items.summary_en: Work relentlessly, attack adversity when things fall apart, and never quit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拼命工作绝不放弃，逆境时更要迎难而上

advice_items.quote: create friendships with your clients... you only need two to three clients focus on them become good friends with them and then be there for them be brothers
advice_items.summary_en: Focus deeply on two to three core clients and build genuine friendships for repeat business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕两三个核心客户，把客户处成真正的朋友

advice_items.quote: cuz people doubt themselves I started to see my results and realized that I was just not going to fail and so I just kept working
advice_items.summary_en: Build unshakable confidence through early results and refuse to doubt yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用成果建立自信，摆脱自我怀疑持续前行

advice_items.quote: give it all to God by the way you want to know the secret of success give it all to God it's all God's plan brother
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and surrender your path to God's plan.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持坚定信仰，怀抱感恩与敬畏之心前行

guests.first_money_or_break: 从亚利桑那大学金融专业毕业后进入Grubb & Ellis（现Newmark）做商业地产，凭借从小在堪萨斯西部农场和牧场长大的背景，靠懂农民、卖土地打开局面。
guests.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Broker & Multi-Business Entrepreneur
guests.zero_start_advice: 不需要雄厚启动资金，要靠头脑和拼命工作；专注服务2-3个核心客户并建立深度友谊，永远不要放弃。

advice_items.quote: I put really focused a types with B type personalities around me so they're calm focused and driven
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with calm, focused, and driven people to balance your creative energy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在身边配置冷静专注且有驱动力的核心人才

advice_items.quote: don't be afraid to take a chance if you don't swing you'll never hit a home run
advice_items.summary_en: Take bold chances and learn from failures instead of waiting forever for perfection.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别怕冒险试错，敢于挥棒才可能打出本垒打

advice_items.quote: entrepreneurs share a passion of they love what they do otherwise you don't work this hard
advice_items.summary_en: Love what you do deeply, because true passion fuels the hard work required.
advice_items.summary_zh: 真正热爱所做的事，热爱才能支撑高强度付出

advice_items.quote: always tell the truth under promise and overd deliver and you'll have customers for life
advice_items.summary_en: Under-promise and over-deliver so clients feel confident buying from you sight unseen.
advice_items.summary_zh: 低承诺高交付，让客户放心成为终身回头客

advice_items.quote: if I shake your hand it's a done deal... honesty integrity and transparency are the three words that we run this company by
advice_items.summary_en: Run your business on honesty, integrity, and transparency where a handshake is binding.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以诚实守信和透明经营，做到一诺千金

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Choose a Supportive Spouse / Life Partner
advice_items.quote: the biggest decision you make in your life is the wife that you marry if they don't love what you do then you're going to have friction
advice_items.summary_en: Marry a partner who shares your passion and becomes part of the solution, not friction.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谨慎选择伴侣，找一个支持并热爱你事业的人

guests.role_or_title: Car Business Entrepreneur & Collector Car Dealer
guests.zero_start_advice: 别害怕冒险试错，敢于挥棒才有机会成功；做生意要始终讲真话、低承诺高交付，并选择志同道合的伴侣。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: I don't think about a box... I think out of the box... what can you provide that other people don't
advice_items.summary_en: Think outside the box to improve processes and deliver value nobody else provides.
advice_items.summary_zh: 跳出常规思维框架，提供别人无法提供的价值

advice_items.quote: 100% honesty period... there's two things you don't break... your balls and your word you never break either one of them
advice_items.summary_en: Negotiate with 100% honesty and never break your word.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判保持百分百诚实，绝对不能违背自己的诺言

advice_items.quote: you just kind of look up and say God show me the way... there was no drugs I've never done a drug in my life I don't drink
advice_items.summary_en: Look to God for guidance and stay completely away from drugs and alcohol.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠信仰指引方向，并坚决远离毒品和酒精

guests.first_money_or_break: 1970年曾睡在车里，后来在麦当劳打工时通过改进铲子和面包架流程把12人的工作缩减到2人，从此靠不断优化效率起步，最终创办拥有多项专利的法庭速记公司并接下深水地平线案赚取2800万美元。
guests.role_or_title: Court Reporting Firm Founder, Lawyer & Patent Holder
guests.zero_start_advice: 远离毒品和酒精，祈祷寻求方向，跳出固有思维观察周围未被满足的需求，提供他人没有的价值。

advice_items.quote: scientifically proven numbers have shown for hundreds of years real estate is the most guaranteed investment you could make
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in real estate as a historically proven, reliable vehicle for building wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择房地产作为经得起历史验证的稳健造富资产

advice_items.quote: the IRS code allows me as a real estate investor to pay $0 in federal income taxes... I have not paid a dollar in federal income tax in seven years
advice_items.summary_en: Understand the tax code and legal real estate tax incentives to minimize tax burden.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用税法与地产投资抵税规则合法降低税务支出

advice_items.quote: delegate to high level people pay people a lot of money you'll attract really high quality people if you pay peanuts you'll get monkeys
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by delegating to top talent and paying well to attract high-quality people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高薪聘请顶尖人才并授权委托，实现企业规模化扩张

advice_items.quote: give up a portion of your ownership in your company to somebody who's the polar opposite and brings different skills... I'd rather have a slice of the pie than 100% of a grape
advice_items.summary_en: Share equity with partners whose skills are the polar opposite of yours to build a bigger business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 愿与能力互补的合伙人分享股权，共同做大蛋糕

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: I have half a billion dollars in my portfolio and I've never used a bank I don't use credit... I do everything creative finance
advice_items.summary_en: Use creative seller financing so cash-flowing properties pay the seller without needing bank loans or your own cash.
advice_items.summary_zh: 利用卖家融资等创意金融手段收购生息资产

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.quote: stop trying to convince the world around you to believe in your vision... if they don't believe in you today they're never going to believe in you move on
advice_items.summary_en: Stop wasting years trying to convince skeptics and move on to people who believe in you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止浪费时间说服怀疑者，远离不认可你的人

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Check In Regularly With Loved Ones
advice_items.quote: reach out to people every once in a while not just New Year's not just Christmas text people that are your friends and just thank them for being your friends
advice_items.summary_en: Regularly reach out and check in on friends and loved ones beyond holidays.
advice_items.summary_zh: 平时多主动联系关心亲友，不要只在节日才问候

advice_items.quote: get around people that are doing more than you are... people better than you will give you permission to become better yourself
advice_items.summary_en: Join communities of high achievers who inspire and give you permission to grow bigger.
advice_items.summary_zh: 融入比自己更优秀的人脉圈，激发更大的成长格局

guests.first_money_or_break: 最早从事建筑承包行业10年，后来转型进入房地产与借贷领域，通过学习卖家融资（Creative Finance）在不动用银行贷款、个人信用和自有资金的情况下收购多户住宅积累资产。
guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Lender & Creative Finance Entrepreneur
guests.zero_start_advice: 打破必须靠银行贷款和自有资金才能买房的传统观念，学习卖家融资等创意金融手段；加入高能量创业社群，远离不相信你愿景的人。
